title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: He gives you one good game that makes you think “oh yeah, this guy will he good.” But then he drops the ball for three straight games
If I drop him now, since games started at 2 p.m., he’ll still be on our roster to start? Or do I have to wait until his game starts
If you drop him now he will be on the roster tonight and on waivers tomorrow
